text:
Maya: Heads-up — Acme Health asked for prescriptive guidance on batching + quant profiles for latency-sensitive endpoints. they want something we can ship in 2 sprints. :wave:
Sam: can you paste the exact ask?
Maya: they run many short-chat calls (avg 80 tokens) and want p99 < 120ms, cost down 40%. asked for config + a small SDK helper.
Ashley: 2 sprints is tight if we include eval-triggered alerts. recommend we split: shipping advisor rules for batching/caching/quant in sprint A, eval alerts + UI in sprint B.
Dmitri: agree. core rule engine + API is a smaller surface. eval-triggered alerts need eval infra + datasets from customers.
Leo: what does "core" include concretely?
Maya: minimal: 1) per-route batching heuristics (window + max_batch_size) 2) prefix/KV caching hints + TTL guidance 3) quantization profile recommendations with safety flags (fp16/8bit fallback) 4) simple SDK call that returns a JSON advice blob.
Sam: acceptance criteria proposal: - API returns advice for a route within 50ms - docs + example app - 3 pilot customers onboarded and able to validate latency/cost numbers within 2 weeks.
Ashley: add: instrumentation events + a new telemetry tag so ops can measure before/after.
Dmitri: for quant we should include regression guardrail: recommended quant profile + "rollback if perplexity delta > X" or eval A/B. otherwise users blast accuracy.
Maya: good call. include a small eval harness in sprint B. but for sprint A just return "recommended_profile": "int8_mixed" plus guidance text.
Leo: can we provide a snippet for the SDK response shape?
Sam: sure — quick example:
```
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "advice": {
    "batching": {"strategy": "time_window", "window_ms": 8, "max_batch": 4},
    "cache": {"enabled": true, "prefix_ttl_s": 30},
    "quant": {"profile": "int8_mixed", "fallback": "fp16"}
  },
  "confidence": "high"
}
```
Ashley: :thumbsup: nice. we should surface conf intervals and expected cost delta estimates. customers always ask for numbers.
Maya: request from Acme: also wants a "safe" config for regulated routes (no quant, longer cache TTL controls). we need policy tags.
Dmitri: so product surfaces: - advisor API + SDK - per-route policy tags (sensitive/regulatory) - telemetry + event schema - docs + example app
Sam: propose M1: advisor API + SDK + docs + telemetry; M2: eval-triggered alerts + UI + policy tagging + pilot expansion.
Ashley: dependencies: - runtime: metric hooks for per-token latency and cost - eng-runtime to expose quant profiles on model variants - infra: small metadata store for TTL defaults - devex: example app + quickstart
Leo: who owns pilot onboarding? I'll take lead for 3 customers (Acme Health, RoverAI, Newsly).
Maya: thanks — Leo leads customer coordination. Ash and Dmitri, can you own API + telemetry work?
Ashley: can do API + docs.
Dmitri: will add telemetry hooks and quant-profile plumbing.
product-bot: Reminder: add a feature flag and opt-in telemetry for pilots.
Sam: launch criteria (draft): 1) API + SDK published, 2) docs + example app, 3) 3 pilots onboarded with measurable p50/p99 and cost delta reports, 4) SLO: p99 within 1.5x baseline for sensitive routes or explicit opt-out, 5) rollback plan for quant regressions.
Maya: timeline: sprint A (2 weeks) — advisor API + SDK + docs + 2 pilots; sprint B (2 weeks) — eval alerts + UI + remaining pilot + hardening. total 4 sprints if we include buffer.
Ashley: risks: - quant regressions - customers won't share eval datasets - infra bandwidth (scheduling/batching changes)
Dmitri: mitigations: - default to safe configs, require explicit opt-in for aggressive quant, provide a simple eval harness customers can run locally, and telemetry-based auto-rollbacks.
Leo: blockers: need runtime support for batching knobs (time-window vs size) — where are we on that?
Dmitri: partial work in progress, we can expose knobs as flags but perf testing required. estimate 5 days.
Maya: next steps: - Ash/Dmitri create PRD section with acceptance tests - Leo start pilot outreach email template - Sam formalize launch criteria + tracking sheet
Sam: I'll make a tracking sheet and tag owners. will post link in #product when ready.
Maya: thanks all. this feels actionable. :rocket:
